comment: Copy to config/robot_link.json (ignored by Git) on the deploy PC. Loopback endpoints only: Studio runs on the same PC as node.py, the SONIC runner and the LIO bridge. Start the node with --odom zmq and the bridge with --forward-cloud. Studio subscribes to odom/cloud/pose/debug and sends node.py only a checked goal (while the robot stands) and stand; Go stays with the operator. limits: goals farther than max_goal_distance_m are refused; a standing robot must read below still_speed_mps and still_yaw_rate_rad_s on LIO for 0.5 s before a goal is sent (not yet measured on hardware: raise them, max 0.5, if LIO sway blocks every goal).
